topic.label: Studio Art Practice
topic.desc: Studio Art Practice: Photography and Moving Image, Sculpture and Installation, New Media and Performance, Critique and Professional Practice, Painting and Drawing.

concepts.label: Critique and Professional Practice
concepts.desc: Studio critique, artist statements, portfolios, exhibitions and grants.

concepts.label: Drawing
concepts.desc: Observational and expressive drawing using line, value, perspective and the figure.

concepts.label: New Media and Performance
concepts.desc: Digital, interactive and time-based art including sound, code, projection and live performance.

concepts.label: Painting
concepts.desc: Painting in oil, acrylic and watercolour with attention to colour theory, surface and composition.

concepts.label: Photography and Moving Image
concepts.desc: Still and moving images made with cameras, from exposure and lighting to editing and sequencing.

concepts.label: Sculpture and Installation
concepts.desc: Three-dimensional work in clay, wood, metal and found materials, and site-specific installation.

skills.label: Artist Statement Writing
skills.desc: Drafts an artist statement and checks it for clarity and consistency with the portfolio work.

skills.label: Portfolio and Grant Preparation
skills.desc: Assembles a portfolio and grant application and checks documentation and requirements against the call.

skills.label: Studio Critique
skills.desc: Runs a structured critique of a work and checks that feedback addresses intent, form and context.

skills.label: Figure and Gesture Study
skills.desc: Guides timed gesture and figure studies and checks anatomy and proportion against reference.

skills.label: Observational Drawing Exercise
skills.desc: Sets an observational drawing exercise and checks the result for proportion, value range and perspective accuracy.

skills.label: Perspective Construction
skills.desc: Constructs one, two and three point perspective for a scene and checks vanishing points and horizon consistency.

skills.label: Interactive Piece Prototyping
skills.desc: Prototypes an interactive or generative artwork in code and checks it runs reliably for the intended duration.

skills.label: Performance Score Writing
skills.desc: Writes a score for a time-based performance and checks timing, roles and documentation plans with a rehearsal.

skills.label: Sound and Projection Design
skills.desc: Designs sound and projection for an installation and checks levels, throw distance and sync on site.

skills.label: Color Mixing and Palette Planning
skills.desc: Plans a limited palette and mixing strategy and checks value and hue relationships with a value study.

skills.label: Composition Planning
skills.desc: Develops thumbnail compositions for a painting and checks balance, focal point and value structure.

skills.label: Painting Media Technique
skills.desc: Advises on oil, acrylic or watercolor technique such as glaze and fat over lean and checks material safety and permanence.

skills.label: Darkroom Processing
skills.desc: Guides film developing and printing and checks chemistry, timing and ventilation against safety guidance.

skills.label: Exposure and Lighting Setup
skills.desc: Sets exposure and lighting for a shoot and checks the result with histogram and test frames.

skills.label: Photo Series Sequencing
skills.desc: Edits and sequences a photo or video series and checks narrative flow with a peer critique pass.

skills.label: Mold Making and Casting
skills.desc: Specifies a mold and casting process in plaster, resin or metal and checks steps against safety data.

skills.label: Fabrication Planning
skills.desc: Plans materials, joins and tools for a sculpture and checks the plan for structural soundness and shop safety.

skills.label: Site-Specific Installation Design
skills.desc: Designs an installation for a given site and checks dimensions, load and audience flow against site constraints.
